data.name: Majjad
data.gender_notes: Majjad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who shines and is radiant. The name Majjad carries the meaning “Shining, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Majjad usually hope their child will grow to embody shining, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who represents the light of Allah in the world
data.etymology: Majjad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shining, Radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Majjad total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مججد
in_arabic.meaning: مججد تعني الشخص الذي يتمتع بصفات عظيمة و حميدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم مججد مشتق من الجذر العربي 'م-ج-د' والذي يعني العظمة و الرفعة. يدل الاسم على الشخص الذي يتمتع بصفات عظيمة و حميدة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة و محمودة في الإسلام. ورد في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، مما يزيد من أهميته و قدسيته.

in_urdu.name: مججد
in_urdu.meaning: مججد یعنی عظیم و خوبیوں والا شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: مججد نام عربی मूल کا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے عظیم و خوبیوں والا۔ یہ نام مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے کیونکہ یہ ایک ایسی شخصیت کی تصویر پیش کرتا ہے جو عظیم خصوصیات کا حامل ہو۔ اس کا تعلق عربی کے 'م-ج-د' جڑ سے ہے، جو عظمت اور رفعت کی علامت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मज्जद
in_hindi.meaning: मज्जद का अर्थ है महान और अच्छे गुणों वाला व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: मज्जद नाम का अर्थ है महान और अच्छे गुणों वाला व्यक्ति। यह नाम अरबी मूल का है और इसका संबंध 'म-ज-द' जड़ से है, जो महानता और ऊंचाई की ओर संकेत करता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम बहुत महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह एक ऐसे व्यक्ति की विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है जो महान और प्रशंसनीय गुणों का मालिक हो।

in_english.name: Majjad
in_english.meaning: Majjad means a person with great and good qualities
in_english.long_meaning: The name Majjad originates from the Arabic root 'm-j-d', which signifies greatness and elevation. It denotes a person who possesses great and commendable qualities. In Islamic tradition, this name holds significant value as it reflects the attributes of an individual who is esteemed and noble. The name Majjad appears in various forms throughout Islamic history and literature.

data.cultural_impact: The name Majjad carries a positive meaning in the Arabic language as it signifies a person who radiates brightness, success, and brilliance. In Islamic culture, it is a name often given to children to instill the desire for them to be successful, bright, and shining lights in their communities and beyond. It can also be associated with the pursuit of knowledge, achievements, and enlightenment. Overall, the name Majjad represents having a powerful influence on and leaving a lasting impact in the world.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Majjad breaks down into two parts, Al-Majjid (the radiant) and Al-Majid (the generous). Al-Majjid is an attribute of God, alluding to His endless mercy, forgiveness, and bountiful blessings. The name Majjad, therefore, carries a profound meaning of being a servant of God, carrying the light of faith and practicing generosity, kindness, and shining brightly through good deeds. In doing so, one can achieve inner fulfillment, spiritual growth, and closeness to their Creator.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Shining, Radiant" symbolizes One who shines and is radiant. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Majjad serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of shining, radiant.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture
